name: iblock
description: High-performance Rust-powered content filtering engine and Manifest V3 extension

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p iblock-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/iblock_wasm.wasm --out-dir dist/wasm --target web && cp dist/wasm/* extension/wasm/
scripts.build:extension: mkdir -p dist && cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/iblock-extension.zip . && cd ..

author: IceBerg-coder
